# VideoGen review by Cisco Diaz on YouTube


Cisco Diaz published "I Tried VideoGen So You Don't Have To (Real Review)" — an honest 12-minute assessment of the platform from an AI content creator's perspective.


Cisco Diaz, an AI-focused content creator, published "I Tried VideoGen So You Don't Have To (Real Review)" — providing an honest assessment of the platform.


## About Cisco Diaz


Cisco Diaz (@ciscodiaz) creates content about AI trends, tips, and tools. His channel helps viewers stay updated with the latest developments in artificial intelligence and learn practical applications.


## The review


In this 11-minute, 58-second video, Cisco provides:


- **Hands-on testing** : Actually using the platform to create videos
- **Real results** : Showing the output quality
- **Honest verdict** : Sharing what works and what could be improved
- **Practical insights** : Tips for getting the best results


## Review style


The "I Tried It So You Don't Have To" format is valuable because:


- It saves viewers time researching
- Provides authentic first-hand experience
- Offers honest opinions without marketing spin
- Shows real results, not just promises


## Why this matters


Reviews from AI-focused creators reach an audience actively seeking AI tools. Cisco's honest assessment helps potential users make informed decisions about VideoGen.
